eligible_data_sources: anonymized order, ticket, transaction, inventory, or signup CSV
read-only PostgreSQL table with non-sensitive columns
synthetic-but-business-shaped export that mirrors a real workflow
written business case when data cannot be shared
evidence_gates: public GitHub issue or public review link
explicit permission to count the redacted result
one concrete useful, confusing, missing, or reproducible finding
confirmation that no private data was posted
not_allowed: customer names, emails, addresses, phone numbers, tokens, secrets, or raw production rows
private evidence that cannot be audited publicly

pilot_scope.name: Scope a safe dataset
pilot_scope.output: Dataset shape, non-sensitive field names, business rule candidates, and permission boundary.

pilot_scope.name: Run a bounded replay
pilot_scope.output: CSV upload or read-only PostgreSQL run with row/column limits and no stored raw data.

pilot_scope.name: Review evidence-backed findings
pilot_scope.output: Useful finding, missed rule, confusing recommendation, or accepted root-cause hypothesis.

pilot_scope.name: Publish redacted evidence
pilot_scope.output: GitHub issue with permission to count, no private data, and a concrete observed result.

purpose: Turn the project from a portfolio demo into a safe pilot-ready offer for people who can bring anonymized business-shaped data or a real data-quality workflow problem.
resume_safe_summary: Published a pilot-ready business data offer with 4 pilot steps, 4 eligible data-source types, 6 evidence gates, a public pilot issue, and zero current external pilot claims.

resume_upgrade_rules.future_resume_line: Validated the agent with an external reviewer on an anonymized business-shaped dataset.
Collected public business-case feedback mapping agent findings to a real workflow risk.
